recreation_brief:
1. Create a 16:9 slide with a white (#FFFFFF) background.
2. Main panel: rounded rectangle spanning ~8%-95% width and ~8%-97% height; fill #FBE3C6; thin 2pt red (#CC0000) border.
3. 'Block Output' tag: white rectangle with 2pt #CC0000 border and bold red (#CC0000) ~14pt text 'Block Output', placed top-left at ~1%-18% width, ~8%-14% height, overlapping the panel's top-left corner.
4. 'Block Input' tag: identical style with text 'Block Input', placed bottom-left at ~1%-18% width, ~91%-97% height, overlapping the panel's bottom-left corner.
5. Vertical title: bold red (#CC0000) ~40pt text 'Encoder Block' in a text box at ~3%-9% width, ~20%-80% height, rotated 270° (PowerPoint 'Rotate all text 270°', i.e. 90° counterclockwise) so it reads bottom-to-top; layer it above the panel.
6. Inside the panel, stack 11 layers bottom-to-top with roughly equal vertical spacing and connect every pair of adjacent layers with a thin orange (#E87722) upward arrow (10 arrow gaps total).
7. Layer 1 (bottom): 7 small token rectangles left-to-right labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄, X₆, X_{N-1}, X_N (bold red #CC0000 letters with numeric subscripts); fills: X₁ #2E75B6, X₂ #FFE135, X₃ #FF9FC5, X₄ #2E75B6, then continue the same blue/yellow/pink cycle for X₆, X_{N-1}, X_N; between X₆ and X_{N-1} add a horizontal cluster of 5 green (#00CC66) dots at ~55%-62% width, ~92% height.
8. Layer 2: full-width maroon (#7E2D5B) bar with bold yellow (#FFE94A) ~20pt text 'Multi Head Self Attention'.
9. Layer 3: row of 7 small token boxes matching the X-row size, spacing and color cycle (source describes them as 'small Y token boxes'; no individual labels specified).
10. Layer 4: row of 7 red (#CC0000) circles, each containing a white '+' (⊕), wrapped in a dashed orange (#E87722) rounded outline.
11. Layer 5: full-width tan (#D9B779) bar with bold-italic dark-red (#8B0000) ~15pt text 'Layer Normalization (NOT Batch Norm)'; the source shows it truncated to 'Layer Normalization (NOT Batch N…' where the right inset (step 20) occludes it — write the full string and let the inset cover the right end.
12. Layer 6: row of 7 small token boxes as in step 9.
13. Layer 7 label: bold-italic dark-red (#8B0000) text 'Feed Forward Networks [ One Hidden wi…' placed above the MLP row; the source string is cut off after 'wi' by the inset panel (step 20) — write at least 'Feed Forward Networks [ One Hidden wi' and let the inset cover the remainder (continuation uncertain, see validation.uncertain_items).
14. Layer 7 boxes: row of 6 pink (#FF9FC5) boxes with purple (#9B2D86) borders, each containing a row of 8 small green (#00A651) filled dots and tiny 'MLP' text; optionally continue a 7th box behind the inset.
15. Layer 8: row of 7 small token boxes as in step 9.
16. Layer 9: second row of 7 red (#CC0000) ⊕ circles wrapped in a dashed orange (#E87722) rounded outline.
17. Layer 10: second full-width tan (#D9B779) bar with the same bold-italic #8B0000 text 'Layer Normalization (NOT Batch Norm)' (right end occluded by the inset as in step 11).
18. Layer 11 (top): 7 output token boxes labeled Y₁, Y₂, Y₃, Y₄, Y₆, Y_{N-1}, Y_N in the X-row style; between Y₆ and Y_{N-1} add a horizontal cluster of 5 blue (#0033CC) dots at ~55%-62% width, ~11% height.
19. Residual skip connections: dashed orange (#E87722) lines from the X row (layer 1) up the side into the layer-4 ⊕ outline, and from the layer-6 token row (the Feed-Forward input row) up the side into the layer-9 ⊕ outline.
20. Right inset panel, drawn ON TOP of the main panel: white rounded rectangle at ~62%-93% width, ~12%-90% height with a thick green (#00A000) ~4pt border; it must occlude the right ends of the full-width bars, the layer-7 label after 'wi', and any 7th MLP box.
21. Inside the inset, bottom: three red (#CC0000) circles with bold white letters V (left), K (center), Q (right); draw a black vertical line from K down to the panel's bottom edge.
22. Black curved arrows from the V and Q circles up into the bottom of a tan (#DEC28B) box labeled 'Multi-Head Attention' (black ~18pt, two lines).
23. Black arrow up from 'Multi-Head Attention' into a light-green (#90EE90) rounded box with dark-green (#2E7D32) text 'Add & Norm'.
24. Black arrow up into a yellow (#E3EF3F) box with gray (#808080) text 'Feed Forward' (two lines).
25. Black arrow up into a second light-green (#90EE90) rounded box with dark-green (#2E7D32) text 'Add & Norm'.
26. Black line from the top 'Add & Norm' exiting upward through the panel's top edge.
27. Thick black rounded residual path up the inset's left side, from below 'Multi-Head Attention' into the top 'Add & Norm'.
28. Thumbnail inset, drawn above the main panel: small white box with green (#00A000) border at ~6%-16% width, ~77%-90% height; tiny dark-green title 'Transformer Encoder'; inside: gray (#BFBFBF) rounded box labeled 'Encoder', a short black arrow pointing up out of it, tiny 'Inputs' text below the box, and a small curved black connector arrow on the left.
29. Slide-number badge, topmost: yellow (#FFFF00) filled circle with a thin outline (outline color unspecified in source) and bold red (#CC0000) '49', at ~91%-98% width, ~10%-17% height, overlapping the main panel's top-right corner.
